CustomField.description: Message shown when the rule fails. Merge fields such as {!PropertyName} or {!newRecord.Name} are filled from your context class. If you write your own context class, put @JsonAccess(serializable='always') on it, or its merge fields stay blank. To show a Custom Label, write {!$Label.MyLabel}. For a label from a managed package with the namespace ns, write {!$Label.ns__MyLabel}. The label is filled from your org's custom labels, in the language of the user who saves the record. A label needs no property on your context class. A label that does not exist stays in the message as written.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Message shown when the rule fails. Merge fields such as {!PropertyName} are filled from your context class, which needs @JsonAccess(serializable='always'). To show a Custom Label, write {!$Label.MyLabel}, or {!$Label.ns__MyLabel} for a managed package label. It is filled in the language of the user who saves the record. A label that does not exist stays as written.
CustomField.label: Error Message
